units: mm (case manifest declaration; not independently calibrated)
width_method: 98th minus 2nd percentile of source vertices projected onto the local arch tangent between neighboring crown seeds; not clinical mesiodistal caliper width

midline.assessment: Above-view inspection places the 41/31 inter-incisor contact near original X=0, Y=-45.5. Separate anterior seeds lie on either side and proceed outward 41/42/43 and 31/32/33. Patient right/left retains the existing lower case convention (negative X=4x, positive X=3x); an unmarked mesh alone does not independently establish anatomical handedness.

limitations: All 14 labels are draft boundaries for subsequent painting, not independently reviewed reference segmentation.
Projected crown outlines cannot establish exact hidden proximal contact or gingival boundaries; uncertain edge faces remain context.
The previous crown-mask envelope is retained as an upper bound on coverage, so gray crown portions may remain for manual review.
Millimeters use the lower manifest declaration; no independent calibration or width-based scaling was applied.
Estimated widths depend on tooth rotation, crown-mask extent and the local arch tangent; outliers need review rather than automatic splitting or resizing.
Neither upper scan/labels nor cross-visit motion artifacts are read or changed by the lower correction generator.
Distal margins of 47/37 are conservatively capped in the projected view; residual width outliers and gray distal crown portions require review.
